title: The Exponential Time Hypothesis is False
importance_reason: public: Lino's YouTube channel, in his own voice, explaining a complexity-theory result experts are still checking; a viewer may repeat any claim
audience: A developer on YouTube who knows roughly what P versus NP is, or has heard of it, and saw the headline that an AI refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. After watching, they can say what 3-SAT and ETH are, how ETH relates to P versus NP, what the paper claims and the core idea of how, why it does not make SAT solvers faster or settle P versus NP, and how far to trust it today.
